meta.name: Material Design 3
meta.description: Material 3 (baseline scheme) for DubBitig: tonal surface containers instead of heavy shadows, pill buttons, an extended FAB, a navigation drawer with a pill indicator and state layers for feedback.
source_references: m3.material.io: Color roles and the baseline (purple) scheme, light and dark
m3.material.io: Shape scale (none, extra-small 4, small 8, medium 12, large 16, extra-large 28, full)
m3.material.io: Elevation levels 0–5 and tonal surface containers
m3.material.io: Motion easing and duration tokens; Interaction states (state layers 8/10/10%)
m3.material.io components: Buttons, FAB, Navigation drawer, Cards, Text fields, Search, Tabs, Switch, Dialogs, Menus
UI/UX Pro Max styles.csv: material-you-md3-mobile ('tonal elevation instead of strong shadows', 'state layers instead of opacity hacks', 'emphasized easing', 'no pure white background')

color.palette_type: analogous tonal palette generated from one seed (baseline violet)

primary.role: primary: filled buttons, active tab indicator, focused field outline, switch track

secondary.role: secondaryContainer: navigation drawer active indicator, selected chips

neutral.usage: #FEF7FF surface (window); #F7F2FA surfaceContainerLow (drawer, elevated cards); #F3EDF7 surfaceContainer; #ECE6F0 surfaceContainerHigh (search bar, dialogs); #E6E0E9 surfaceContainerHighest (filled fields, hover); #CAC4D0 outlineVariant (dividers); #79747E outline (field and outlined-button borders); #6F6A77 hint text; #49454F onSurfaceVariant (secondary text); #1D1B20 onSurface (text)

color.contrast_strategy: tonal layers: each container tier is a step darker (light) or lighter (dark); on-colours guarantee 4.5:1

dark_mode.neutral_usage: #141218 surface; #1D1B20 surfaceContainerLow; #211F26 surfaceContainer; #2B2930 surfaceContainerHigh; #36343B surfaceContainerHighest / hover; #49454F outlineVariant; #938F99 outline and hint text; #CAC4D0 onSurfaceVariant; #E6E0E9 onSurface

accessible_text_variants.note: Official values below WCAG AA 4.5:1 as text on these surfaces, nudged toward black (light) or white (dark) keeping the hue; enforced by tests/design-dna.test.ts.

typography.font_style_notes: Geometric-humanist Roboto; headlines and titles are regular weight (hierarchy by size), labels are medium 500 with positive tracking.

spacing.section_rhythm: 16px inside containers, 24px between cards, 56px top-level touch targets

layout.grid_system: Canonical list-detail layout with a standard navigation drawer

shape.border_usage: only on outlined components (outlined buttons, text fields, chips); containers are separated by tone

elevation.shadow_style: layered but light; tone carries most of the depth
elevation.depth_cues: color intensity (surface container tiers) first, shadow levels 1–3 second

iconography.style: Material Symbols outlined, filled when selected
iconography.preferred_set: Material Symbols (app keeps Phosphor/Lucide regular weight)

components.button_style: Filled: primary fill, onPrimary label, 40px high, full pill, label large 14/500. Outlined: 1px outline, primary label. Hover adds an 8% state layer of the label colour, press 10%.
components.input_style: Outlined text field: 4px radius, 1px outline; focus = 2px primary outline; no background fill.
components.card_style: Elevated card: surfaceContainerLow, 12px radius, elevation level 1, no border; hover raises to level 2.
components.navigation_pattern: Standard navigation drawer on surfaceContainerLow; items 40px (desktop density: the M3 spec uses 56dp, reduced so the 16-item drawer fits the default 940px window), full-pill active indicator in secondaryContainer with onSecondaryContainer label; extended FAB (primaryContainer, 16px radius, 56px) above the list.
components.modal_style: Dialog: surfaceContainerHigh, 28px radius, level 3, headline small 24px regular title.
components.component_notes: Search bar: 56px, full pill, surfaceContainerHigh, no outline. Primary tabs: 48px, 3px primary indicator under the active label. Switch: 52×32 track; off = 2px outline track with 16px outline handle, on = primary track with 24px onPrimary handle. Chips: 32px, 8px radius.

aesthetic.visual_metaphor: tinted paper surfaces stacked by tone

visual_language.visual_weight_distribution: primary actions are large shapes (FAB, pill buttons)
visual_language.focal_strategy: single hero element (the extended FAB) plus content

composition.hierarchy_method: scale contrast of shapes and type, colour roles

interaction_feel.hover_behavior: state-layer overlay and +1 elevation level on cards and FAB
interaction_feel.loading_style: circular / linear progress indicator in primary

overview.fallback_strategy: reduce to CSS: transitions stop under prefers-reduced-motion

visual_effects.composite_notes: Material 3 relies on tonal containers and state layers, not effects. Ripple is approximated by the 10% pressed state layer. onSurfaceVariant hint text (#6F6A77) sits between outline and onSurfaceVariant so 12px hints keep 4.5:1 on all containers.
